summary: Iteration 3 verifies Bearer-only auth (withCredentials:false) after the CORS + credentials fix. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass in test_auth_restoration.py (10 pre-existing + 4 new for /api/auth/me via Bearer, /api/auth/refresh via body, missing-token rejection). Frontend (preview, same-origin): admin@clanchat.app and bob@clanchat.app both log in and land on /feed; tokens are stored in localStorage under 'clanchat_access_token' + 'clanchat_refresh_token'; /api/auth/me returns 200 with role=admin using Authorization: Bearer + credentials:'omit' (no cookies); Admin nav renders and /admin loads with USERS/POSTS/PENDING REPORTS counters; POST /api/upload/signed-url with Bearer-only auth returns 200 with a Supabase upload_url; /register page renders. Zero CORS / withCredentials / access-control errors in the browser console.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> in Admin.jsx L365 (reportsCategoryCounts). Unchanged from iteration_2, not a regression from the CORS/Bearer fix.

critical_code_review_comments: api.js: request interceptor correctly injects Authorization: Bearer from tokenCache; performRefresh posts refresh_token in body with withCredentials:false — verified against backend.
AuthContext: rememberToken() persists both access_token and refresh_token to localStorage — verified in browser storage.
Backend /api/auth/me still supports either access_token cookie OR Authorization: Bearer (per test_credentials.md notes) — Bearer path confirmed working with credentials:'omit'.

CORS: allow_origin_regex covers preview/emergent.host/clanchat.app/localhost/capacitor — cross-origin production behavior can only be validated post-redeploy against clanchat.app; preview is same-origin so this iteration cannot exercise the actual cross-origin path.
